title: google/elephant-goldfish-model
lede: Elephant Goldfish Model is a Google plugin for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity that drafts a software design with full project context, then has fresh agents with no chat history review it.

points: The Elephant agent keeps your project's context and writes the specification; Goldfish reviewers see only the document and its sources.
Starting reviewers without the earlier conversation is meant to surface assumptions the drafting session never stated.
Skills cover brainstorming, drafting, resolving findings, bootstrapping docs for an existing codebase, reviews and drift reports.
A drift report compares design documents with the current code and lists where the two disagree.
Reviews stop if the agent cannot create fresh subagents. Apache 2.0, and not an officially supported Google product.

points.text: Support for OpenCode is the main open request, tracked as verified support for both its first and second versions.
The earlier OpenCode V1 issue is still open alongside it, labelled for test harness and isolation work.
